import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 领取杀神称号
 * 指令：/领取杀神称号
 *
 * 条件：杀神榜上榜人数 ≥ 10，且自身是榜一
 */

import App from '@src/response-apps/killGodList/claimTitle/app';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;

  const result = await App({ bid, uid, request: createBackendRequestContext(e) });
  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  switch (result.code) {
    case 'OK':
      md.addText('「杀神」称号已发放至你的称号列表，可前往我的称号进行佩戴。');
      break;
    case 'ALREADY_CLAIMED':
      md.addText('你已持有「杀神」称号。');
      break;
    case 'LIST_TOO_SHORT':
      md.addText('杀神榜当前上榜人数不足 10 人，暂不开放领取。');
      break;
    case 'NOT_RANK1':
      md.addText('仅杀神榜榜一可领取此称号。');
      break;
    case 'TITLE_NOT_FOUND':
      md.addText('称号尚未配置，请联系管理员。');
      break;
    case 'LOCK_FAIL':
      md.addText('操作繁忙，请稍后再试。');
      break;
    default:
      md.addText('领取失败，请稍后再试。');
  }

  const footer = [
    { label: '杀神榜', command: '/杀神榜' },
    { label: '我的称号', command: '/我的称号' }
  ];

  void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '领取杀神称号', content: md, footer }));
});
